title: Kurashiru: some Recichalle and Chirashi data leaked via PLAID KARTE breach
date_note: Date of Kurashiru's own notice; the notice says Plaid reported the leak to it on 15 November.
geo_basis: country as the sources state (Japanese company); no city given in the pages read
summary: Kurashiru's 20 November notice says a third party gained unauthorized access to PLAID's KARTE service, leaking part of the data it had linked to it. It lists records of some Recichalle customers and the email addresses of Kurashiru Chirashi accounts, with the counts given in Japanese in the notice. The notice says some leaked data sat in KARTE environments under contracts already ended, and that no secondary damage has been confirmed.
plain: Kurashiru says data it had linked to PLAID's KARTE leaked, covering some Recichalle customers' records and Chirashi account email addresses.
exec: A vendor breach exposed some Recichalle records, and data from ended contracts was still stored at the vendor, Kurashiru's notice says.
action: Kurashiru advises Chirashi partners not to open links or attachments in unfamiliar emails or enter IDs or passwords; it says Recichalle users need take no action.
